text: KVTR relays are available for single or multi-shot, 3-pole autoreclosing of a circuit breaker on distribution or transmission systems. They are user-friendly and flexible in their operating logic.
heading: Multi-shot 3-pole Auto-reclose Relay

text: As part of the K relay range, the KVTR can be integrated into an overall protection and control scheme via its integral serial communications facility. KVTR can be configured for both automatic reclosing and manual reclosing interlock and applied on all power systems from distribution to transmission voltages.
